findings: commercial:grin is presented on its official homepage as 'Creator marketing for brands' and runs gifting, affiliate, and paid programs for brands; it is brand-side influencer marketing, not the creator-side sponsorship management system required by creator-sponsorship-management.

commercial:greenfly is presented on its official homepage as high-performance content operations for sports/entertainment; its center of gravity is content capture, organization, distribution, and measurement, not persistent fan profiles plus organization-run engagement activities with participation captured back into fan records as required by fan-engagement-platform.
